recordStatus: Experimental guidance; not validated in a product flow. The record structure is provisional.

sourceOfTruth.implementation: none — no empty-collection product flow or EmptyState component has been built
sourceOfTruth.explorerResult: app/src/App.tsx imports and renders this JSON directly; the Explorer displays guidance, not the suggested product flow

demonstratedIntent.value: Show that there is no content yet
demonstratedIntent.note: Existing Slice 01 suggestion. Exact normalized match only. The generic phrase does not establish why content is absent; the first-use context below is an explicit assumption, not inferred user context.

purpose.value: Help someone understand why a collection has no items yet and what, if anything, they can do next.

scopedScenario.value: This example assumes a successfully loaded, unfiltered collection that the person can access, with no items created yet. Confirm this context before applying the guidance.
scopedScenario.note: Chosen experimental scenario under Daniel’s authorization to explore Empty State; the product recommendation remains a hypothesis.

value: The collection loaded successfully and contains no items yet.
The person is allowed to view the collection, and search or filters are not hiding existing items.
Content is still loading or could not be loaded.
Search or filters returned no matches.
The person cannot access the collection, or items existed and were removed.
Name what is missing in plain language, such as “No projects yet.”
Explain the available next step, or explain why there is currently no action the person can take.
If the person can create the first item, offer one clearly named action that opens that existing creation flow.
If the person cannot create an item, explain the constraint. Offer an alternative only when the product actually supports it; no action is a valid outcome.
actionAvailability.note: This is conditional product guidance, not a fixed requiredActions list. Permissions and creation capabilities belong to the consuming product, not Clara.

stateDistinctions.guidance: Do not conclude that a collection is empty before its result is known.
Explain that the current query has no matches and point to an available way to change it; do not imply the collection has no items.
Describe the failure and available recovery instead of claiming there is no content.
Explain the access constraint without implying that the collection is empty or offering an unavailable creation action.

composition.component: Owned by the consuming product. No new Clara EmptyState container is needed to describe this guidance.
Existing heading and body text styles can express the content hierarchy.
Existing Clara Button if the product provides an authorized creation action; otherwise omit the action. No new Button variant is proposed.

value: This demonstration matches one phrase, not synonyms or a class of empty-state intents.
No real collection, permission check, creation action, or accessibility behavior is implemented by this Knowledge record.
Guidance is a product-design hypothesis, not observed usability evidence.

unresolved: Can this guidance be applied correctly by a consumer who encounters a different reason for missing content?
Does actionAvailability generalize to other Patterns, or is this field specific to empty collections?
Should the generic intent first ask for context rather than show this explicitly scoped example?
What accessibility behavior is needed when a real collection changes from loading to empty or from empty to populated?
